captain.name: Captain Trevenen
captain.description: A native Cornish man from a fishing village in Cornwall, England, aged about fifty-five. STRONG RHOTIC CORNISH / WEST COUNTRY ACCENT is essential: clearly pronounce every r in words such as furl, foremast, starboard, work and anchor. Broad rural West Country vowels, rolled or strongly curled r, a recognisable southwestern English burr. Earthy, gravelly, weathered low male voice with a natural chest rasp. A working sailing master calling crisp practical orders across the deck of an old wooden sailing ship. Forceful human projection, brisk speech, never a polished narrator or theatrical pirate. Completely dry voice, no ambience or music. Entirely original fictional character, no imitation of a real person.
captain.preview: [shouts] Make full sail! [pause] Reef the sails! [pause] Furl all sails! [pause] Batten down the hatches! [pause] Let go the anchor! [pause] Heave away!

orders.text: [shouts] Shorten sail! Batten down the hatches!
[shouts] Hands to the yards! Transfer to leeward!
[shouts] All hands, weigh anchor! Heave away!
